subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Boss Email Scam
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Boss Email Scam.

hook.text: Your CEO emails urgently: 'Wire $50,000 to this account immediately. Don't tell anyone.'

buildup.text: Business email compromise uses spoofed or hacked executive emails to authorize fake payments.

discovery.text: The FBI calls it the most financially damaging cybercrime — losses exceed $2.7 billion annually.

twist.text: The scam works because employees are trained to follow instructions from leadership quickly.

climax.text: A simple phone call to verify the request would stop most BEC scams — but urgency prevents it.

punchline.text: Obedience is a virtue — until the boss is a scammer.

quiz.question: What is business email compromise (BEC)?
options: Using spoofed executive emails to authorize fake payments
